body: Fixed in 4fc3fc87f. sourcePageKey now returns null when required fields are missing and uses JSON-array serialization for collision-resistant deterministic page keys; the caller keeps incomplete candidates blocked.

Fixed in 4fc3fc87f. Added regression coverage for missing and malformed source-map inputs, plus a missing render-result blocker regression. Focused Jest now covers 7 tests across the source-page and source-map suites.

Fixed in 4fc3fc87f. Source-map loading now fails closed for missing files, malformed JSON, non-object payloads, or non-array rows; it returns an empty manifest, source_map_load validator failure, diagnostic code, and readback instead of throwing.

Fixed in 4fc3fc87f. Row mapping status now compares required source_page_render_ids against renderResultsById and adds missing_render_result blockers for any missing IDs, preventing false-positive mapped_to_rendered_source_page status.
Fixed in 4fc3fc87f. compareNatural now has explicit null/undefined ordering before using the shared Intl.Collator path, preserving natural sorting while making the null-safety visible.
Fixed in 4fc3fc87f. estimateNonblankPixelSignal now reads the full image data buffer once and indexes sampled pixels directly, avoiding getImageData calls inside the nested sample loop.
